Return exactly the supplied author JSON schema. Use:

- constraints for material requirements, prerequisites, prohibition, conditions,

- typed relations for explicit links, preserving direction, meaning, conditions,

- latitude for expressly permitted and forbidden variation;

Preserve every material source condition, exception, quantifier, modal/result
distinction, applicability distinction and refusal boundary. Compactness means
remove repetition, not remove obligations. Conditions/exceptions arrays must

dependency from connectivity or confidence scores. If source semantics exceed
the five active families, describe them as concepts/constraints and explicitly
retain any lost operational detail as a residual. Document/template processing
does not execute the workflow or instantiate the represented Product.

Graphify discovery, when supplied, is a fallible acquisition aid. It can suggest
concepts and relationships to inspect; exact source governs your interpretation.
INFERRED/AMBIGUOUS edges are not normative assertions. Cross-file graph nodes
outside the supplied source are discovery leads only; retain unresolved
dependencies as explicit residuals rather than fabricate meanings or endpoints.

Use stable snake_case keys derived from the named entity or rule, not line
numbers, chunk numbers, ordinal sequences or transient extraction IDs. All keys
are local to this call and globally unique across its five arrays. Relation
endpoints and constraint/latitude targets must be local concepts. Residual
subjects must be another local concept/relation/constraint/latitude. Source
repetition may motivate repeated local concepts; do not silently resolve
cross-chunk or cross-document identity by matching labels.

Every record needs at least one grounding entry: a supplied section_id, exact
absolute start/end line numbers inside that section, and an EXACT source quote
within those lines. Do not normalize spelling, punctuation or whitespace in
the quote. Grounded quotation proves source re-entry, not fidelity of the whole
authored statement. Ground separately when several sections justify a record.

Return one disposition for EACH supplied section_id with no duplicates:
- retained: selected records retain this section's interpretation;

Retained/residual sections require at least one selected record grounded in

empty section may be omitted with an explicit reason. A disposition records a
processing choice, never proves semantic completeness. Record material
limitations, omissions and unresolved cross-chunk dependencies in limitations.

[{"end_line":196,"heading":"REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS - Addressable Public Contract Catalog/Required Contract Groups","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md#REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS%20-%20Addressable%20Public%20Contract%20Catalog%2FRequired%20Contract%20Groups","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md","sha256":"4e44ff47f916b8a0ea167fbcf52620d56a37c8bfec6087e8f0b3fa021e80cbd4","start_line":79,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md","lines":[{"number":79,"text":"## Required Contract Groups
"},{"number":80,"text":"
"},{"number":81,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-005**: The ABG 5.0 TypeScript product shall publish
"},{"number":82,"text":"these contract-group identities and package export locators. The root export
"},{"number":83,"text":"`.` may aggregate them but shall not replace their addressable identities.
"},{"number":84,"text":"
"},{"number":85,"text":"| Contract group identity | TypeScript package export | Required content |
"},{"number":86,"text":"|---|---|---|
"},{"number":87,"text":"| `abg.contract.gtl.m01` | `@abiogenesis/typescript-tenant/gtl/m01` | GTL graph, declaration, admission, canonical serialization, algebra, C, refinement, diagnostic carrier contracts |
"},{"number":88,"text":"| `abg.contract.gtl.m02` | `@abiogenesis/typescript-tenant/gtl/m02` | Module, publication, lookup, descriptor-facing declaration contracts |
"},{"number":89,"text":"| `abg.contract.gtl.requirements` | `@abiogenesis/typescript-tenant/gtl/requirements` | GTL requirement declaration and relation contracts |
"},{"number":90,"text":"| `abg.contract.abg.requirements` | `@abiogenesis/typescript-tenant/abg/requirements` | ABG requirement and proof-carry contracts |
"},{"number":91,"text":"| `abg.contract.abg.m03` | `@abiogenesis/typescript-tenant/abg/m03` | runtime event, admission, catalog, traversal, result, replay, continuation, and conformance contracts |
"},{"number":92,"text":"| `abg.contract.abg.transport` | `@abiogenesis/typescript-tenant/abg/m03/transport` | replaceable transport input/result contracts; no runtime authority |
"},{"number":93,"text":"| `abg.contract.app.m04` | `@abiogenesis/typescript-tenant/app/m04` | installed public SDK operation, workspace, catalog, invocation, result, replay, F_H, and installer contracts |
"},{"number":94,"text":"| `abg.contract.qualification.m05` | `@abiogenesis/typescript-tenant/qualification/m05` | qualification, release-snapshot, manifest, and evidence contracts |
"},{"number":95,"text":"| `abg.asset.gtl.language-conformance-corpus` | product-manifest asset locator | canonical GTL programs paired with exact expected diagnostic identities |
"},{"number":96,"text":"
"},{"number":97,"text":"The complete public function surface shall derive from one closed
"},{"number":98,"text":"`PublicFunctionDefinition<K>` family. That family owns each function identity,
"},{"number":99,"text":"closed variant domain, request/result/refusal contracts, authority and effect
"},{"number":100,"text":"class, operation-indexed workspace-binding requirement, capability refs, and
"},{"number":101,"text":"adapter coordinates. Package exports, operation catalog rows, schemas, SDK
"},{"number":102,"text":"methods, and CLI paths are projections of that family; they shall not author
"},{"number":103,"text":"parallel function meaning.
"},{"number":104,"text":"
"},{"number":105,"text":"The `abg.contract.abg.executive` group and
"},{"number":106,"text":"`@abiogenesis/typescript-tenant/abg/executive` locator are reserved candidate
"},{"number":107,"text":"identities for the planned 5.1 observer/tuner Product. ABIogenesis 5.0 does not
"},{"number":108,"text":"publish or require them.
"},{"number":109,"text":"
"},{"number":110,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-006**: The `abg.contract.abg.m03` roster shall locate
"},{"number":111,"text":"the named symbols `RuntimeEvent`, `CanonicalRuntimeEvent`, and
"},{"number":112,"text":"`RUNTIME_EVENT_KIND_VALUES`; `GtlProgramDiagnosticId` and
"},{"number":113,"text":"`GTL_PROGRAM_DIAGNOSTIC_ID_VALUES`; `GTL_PROGRAM_REPAIR_EDIT_CLASS_VALUES` and
"},{"number":114,"text":"`GTL_PROGRAM_DEFAULT_ADMISSIBLE_REPAIRS`; and
"},{"number":115,"text":"`admitGtlProgramConformanceInput` and `typecheckGtlProgram`. The value arrays are
"},{"number":116,"text":"the machine-readable closed rosters for their type unions.
"},{"number":117,"text":"
"},{"number":118,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-006A**: The public contract catalog shall contain
"},{"number":119,"text":"these mandatory schema, vocabulary, and corpus row identities. A row may share
"},{"number":120,"text":"one export group or schema document with other rows, but it shall retain its own
"},{"number":121,"text":"identity, version, digest, authority refs, and locator:
"},{"number":122,"text":"
"},{"number":123,"text":"- `abg.schema.product-toolchain-manifest`
"},{"number":124,"text":"- `abg.schema.public-contract-catalog`
"},{"number":125,"text":"- `abg.schema.public-operation-contract`
"},{"number":126,"text":"- `abg.schema.public-operation-invocation`
"},{"number":127,"text":"- `abg.schema.public-operation-outcome`
"},{"number":128,"text":"- `abg.schema.native-contract-inventory`
"},{"number":129,"text":"- `abg.schema.capability-contract`
"},{"number":130,"text":"- `abg.schema.closed-vocabulary`
"},{"number":131,"text":"- `abg.schema.gtl-graph-function`
"},{"number":132,"text":"- `abg.schema.gtl-module`
"},{"number":133,"text":"- `abg.schema.gtl-c-program`
"},{"number":134,"text":"- `abg.schema.gtl-program-conformance-input`
"},{"number":135,"text":"- `abg.schema.catalog-product-descriptor`
"},{"number":136,"text":"- `abg.schema.catalog-contribution-manifest`
"},{"number":137,"text":"- `abg.schema.resolved-product-lock`
"},{"number":138,"text":"- `abg.schema.workspace-binding`
"},{"number":139,"text":"- `abg.schema.install-manifest`
"},{"number":140,"text":"- `abg.schema.installer-manifest`
"},{"number":141,"text":"- `abg.schema.catalog-admission`
"},{"number":142,"text":"- `abg.schema.host-invocation`
"},{"number":143,"text":"- `abg.schema.runtime-event`
"},{"number":144,"text":"- `abg.schema.runtime-result`
"},{"number":145,"text":"- `abg.schema.runtime-replay`
"},{"number":146,"text":"- `abg.schema.fh-interaction`
"},{"number":147,"text":"- `abg.schema.tenant-conformance-manifest`
"},{"number":148,"text":"- `abg.schema.self-conformance-result`
"},{"number":149,"text":"- `abg.schema.exact-candidate-qualification`
"},{"number":150,"text":"- `abg.schema.consensus-subject`
"},{"number":151,"text":"- `abg.schema.consensus-panel`
"},{"number":152,"text":"- `abg.schema.consensus-reviewer-profile`
"},{"number":153,"text":"- `abg.schema.review-findings`
"},{"number":154,"text":"- `abg.schema.review-rulings`
"},{"number":155,"text":"- `abg.schema.consensus-round-policy`
"},{"number":156,"text":"- `abg.schema.consensus-round-outcome`
"},{"number":157,"text":"- `abg.schema.consensus-result`
"},{"number":158,"text":"- `abg.schema.ticket-consensus-projection`
"},{"number":159,"text":"- `abg.schema.release-snapshot`
"},{"number":160,"text":"- `abg.schema.a5-r1-release-manifest`
"},{"number":161,"text":"- `abg.vocabulary.runtime-event-kind`
"},{"number":162,"text":"- `abg.vocabulary.gtl-program-diagnostic-id`
"},{"number":163,"text":"- `abg.vocabulary.gtl-program-repair-edit-class`
"},{"number":164,"text":"- `abg.vocabulary.review-ruling-kind`
"},{"number":165,"text":"- `abg.vocabulary.consensus-round-outcome`
"},{"number":166,"text":"- `abg.asset.gtl.language-conformance-corpus`
"},{"number":167,"text":"
"},{"number":168,"text":"Canonical schema documents and addressable schema projections shall derive
"},{"number":169,"text":"from one schema-definition source. Independent authoring of equivalent native,
"},{"number":170,"text":"serialized, operation, and catalog schemas is not lawful merely because each
"},{"number":171,"text":"projection retains a distinct public identity.
"},{"number":172,"text":"
"},{"number":173,"text":"`abg.schema.exact-candidate-qualification` shall locate one authoritative
"},{"number":174,"text":"schema document with addressable definitions for
"},{"number":175,"text":"`ExactCandidateQualification<basis>`,
"},{"number":176,"text":"`ExactCandidateQualification<verdict>`, `QualificationLawBasis`,
"},{"number":177,"text":"`QualificationCoverageCatalog`, and `QualificationVerdictInput`. The basis and verdict
"},{"number":178,"text":"are addressable projections of the Prime qualification family;
"},{"number":179,"text":"`QualificationLawBasis`, coverage and the native F11-result input remain
"},{"number":180,"text":"subordinate definitions and shall not become independently authored schema
"},{"number":181,"text":"identities.
"},{"number":182,"text":"
"},{"number":183,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-007**: The language conformance corpus shall be one
"},{"number":184,"text":"canonical content-addressed JSON product asset. Its catalog row shall locate
"},{"number":185,"text":"the asset and schema, bind its digest, and name the diagnostic-vocabulary
"},{"number":186,"text":"contract it expects. Test-only location is not publication.
"},{"number":187,"text":"
"},{"number":188,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-007A**: The GTL serialization rows shall locate the
"},{"number":189,"text":"native symbol pairs `admitGraphFunction`/`serializeGraphFunction`,
"},{"number":190,"text":"`admitModule`/`serializeModule`, and
"},{"number":191,"text":"`admitCProgramSyntax`/`serializeCProgramCanonical`, plus
"},{"number":192,"text":"`GtlProgramConformanceInput`/`admitGtlProgramConformanceInput`. The installer
"},{"number":193,"text":"rows shall locate `AbgTypescriptInstallerManifest` and the exact canonical
"},{"number":194,"text":"install-manifest schema. Equivalent later symbols require a versioned catalog
"},{"number":195,"text":"row and supersession; broad M01/M02/M04 group membership alone is not a schema locator.
"},{"number":196,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":268,"heading":"REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS - Addressable Public Contract Catalog/Public Operation Identities","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md#REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS%20-%20Addressable%20Public%20Contract%20Catalog%2FPublic%20Operation%20Identities","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md","sha256":"7021531a3e7e58150203995d30cbc873c4bce853e27b4ad319f3968e9e0676ed","start_line":197,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md","lines":[{"number":197,"text":"## Public Operation Identities
"},{"number":198,"text":"
"},{"number":199,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-008**: The public operation catalog shall derive the
"},{"number":200,"text":"following tenant-invariant 5.0 operation identities from the same
"},{"number":201,"text":"`PublicFunctionDefinition<K>` family. Their stable identities and semantics
"},{"number":202,"text":"decompose Product behavior; their count is a derived no-silence projection and
"},{"number":203,"text":"shall not define Product scope or substitute for an outcome scenario:
"},{"number":204,"text":"
"},{"number":205,"text":"| Operation identity | Closed variation |
"},{"number":206,"text":"|---|---|
"},{"number":207,"text":"| `abg.operation.workspace.create` | target plus explicit `clean` or `imported` creation policy |
"},{"number":208,"text":"| `abg.operation.workspace.open` | expected stable workspace-authority basis plus readiness projection |
"},{"number":209,"text":"| `abg.operation.project.read` | closed source/projection relation for catalog, runtime, evidence, replay, gaps, and lawful actions |
"},{"number":210,"text":"| `abg.operation.product.verify` | artifact format and contract |
"},{"number":211,"text":"| `abg.operation.product.resolve` | product requirements |
"},{"number":212,"text":"| `abg.operation.product.install` | install target policy |
"},{"number":213,"text":"| `abg.operation.workspace.bind` | exact product set, dependency lock, and roots |
"},{"number":214,"text":"| `abg.operation.catalog.admit` | admitted contribution family |
"},{"number":215,"text":"| `abg.operation.catalog.view` | narrowing allowlist |
"},{"number":216,"text":"| `abg.operation.catalog.apply` | `node_type` or `overlay`; both non-callable |
"},{"number":217,"text":"| `abg.operation.run.invoke` | `invoke` or `start` |
"},{"number":218,"text":"| `abg.operation.run.continue` | automatic current-intent continuation or a newly admitted selected action; native human-response-driven resumption is reserved for 5.1 |
"},{"number":219,"text":"| `abg.operation.result.assess` | declared result-assessment contract |
"},{"number":220,"text":"| `abg.operation.witness.admit` | `reprice`, `attest`, `hygiene-stamp`, `intake`, `run-resumed`, or `run-stopped` |
"},{"number":221,"text":"| `abg.operation.conformance.evaluate` | public `gtl_program`; self-conformance remains qualification-bound |
"},{"number":222,"text":"| `abg.operation.product.materialize` | `context_bootstrap` or `configuration` |
"},{"number":223,"text":"| `abg.operation.release.snapshot` | `published_rc` or `tapped_release` |
"},{"number":224,"text":"
"},{"number":225,"text":"Observer-report, observer-drafts, and tuning-report `project.read` variants and
"},{"number":226,"text":"`abg.operation.tuning.transition` are reserved candidate identities for
"},{"number":227,"text":"ABIogenesis 5.1. They are excluded from the closed 5.0 operation family.
"},{"number":228,"text":"
"},{"number":229,"text":"`abg.operation.interaction.respond` and its closed `select`, `approve`,
"},{"number":230,"text":"`reject`, `assess` and `answer_escalation` variants are also reserved for 5.1.
"},{"number":231,"text":"Their response-driven `run.continue` use is excluded from 5.0 qualification;
"},{"number":232,"text":"automatic continuation and distinct new-action admission remain required.
"},{"number":233,"text":"This allocation does not grant a response capability to a direct-invoke root
"},{"number":234,"text":"or permit an adapter to simulate the missing native path.
"},{"number":235,"text":"
"},{"number":236,"text":"This is a hard break. Every non-derived legacy operation identity, facade,
"},{"number":237,"text":"parallel register, default, or fallback shall be retired. CLI command paths may
"},{"number":238,"text":"retain ergonomic spellings only when they bind one definition above and supply
"},{"number":239,"text":"no independent semantics.
"},{"number":240,"text":"
"},{"number":241,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-009**: Every operation row shall locate exact request,
"},{"number":242,"text":"result, error/refusal, and invocation-descriptor schemas and native symbols. It
"},{"number":243,"text":"shall declare defaults, closed value domains, actor requirements, read/write or
"},{"number":244,"text":"attestation class, event-admission behavior, terminal/non-terminal disposition,
"},{"number":245,"text":"adapter exit classification, and the operation-and-variant-indexed
"},{"number":246,"text":"`workspaceBindingRequirement` value `forbidden | exactly_one`. No concrete
"},{"number":247,"text":"variant shall carry a freely optional workspace binding. Prose spelling, CLI
"},{"number":248,"text":"parsing, prior examples, or adapter convention shall not supply a missing field.
"},{"number":249,"text":"
"},{"number":250,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-010**: One common host-neutral
"},{"number":251,"text":"`PublicInvocation<K>` descriptor family and one corresponding
"},{"number":252,"text":"`PublicOutcome<K>` result/refusal/non-terminal family shall themselves be
"},{"number":253,"text":"catalog rows and schemas, shall serve every public operation, and shall remain
"},{"number":254,"text":"governed by the selected `PublicFunctionDefinition<K>` and owning semantic
"},{"number":255,"text":"function. The invocation shall bind the exact public
"},{"number":256,"text":"function definition and variant, contract-catalog version, operation identity,
"},{"number":257,"text":"operation-indexed invocation authority, required workspace/product/lock/
"},{"number":258,"text":"catalog-view identities, selected admitted GTL program and GraphFunction where
"},{"number":259,"text":"execution-scoped, input identity, allowlist, capability grants, steering inputs,
"},{"number":260,"text":"actor attribution when required, and expected result/error schema identities.
"},{"number":261,"text":"Pre-binding variants shall forbid workspace binding; workspace- and
"},{"number":262,"text":"execution-scoped variants shall require exactly one immutable binding. The
"},{"number":263,"text":"descriptor shall contain no worker, continuation, event, traversal, retry,
"},{"number":264,"text":"selection, evaluation, or closure authority. The owning semantic function shall
"},{"number":265,"text":"construct the outcome; public ingress may validate, admit, and transport the
"},{"number":266,"text":"invocation and transport its outcome, but shall not construct either operation
"},{"number":267,"text":"semantics or outcome truth.
"},{"number":268,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":315,"heading":"REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS - Addressable Public Contract Catalog/Capability Catalog","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md#REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS%20-%20Addressable%20Public%20Contract%20Catalog%2FCapability%20Catalog","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md","sha256":"4d5a97b81067af1def85671dfb8d84dcad00383beec1e41c4432ca29ff95c967","start_line":269,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md","lines":[{"number":269,"text":"## Capability Catalog
"},{"number":270,"text":"
"},{"number":271,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-011**: Each public contract row shall publish its
"},{"number":272,"text":"capability identities as stable strings of the form
"},{"number":273,"text":"`abg.capability.<domain>.<name>@<major>`. At minimum, the catalog shall include
"},{"number":274,"text":"capabilities for GTL declaration/admission/serialization, Module publication,
"},{"number":275,"text":"catalog contribution and GraphFunction invocation, node-type and overlay
"},{"number":276,"text":"application, seven-term C execution, F_P result admission/materialization,
"},{"number":277,"text":"runtime events/replay/continuation, the complete public operator contract,
"},{"number":278,"text":"installed-product binding and qualification-bound self-conformance.
"},{"number":279,"text":"Consensus capability publication is optional in 5.0 under
"},{"number":280,"text":"[Product Release Boundaries](../../PRODUCT.md#50-and-51-release-boundaries);
"},{"number":281,"text":"an actual published claim still binds its exact function and declared contract.
"},{"number":282,"text":"
"},{"number":283,"text":"The mandatory ABIogenesis 5.0 capability identities are:
"},{"number":284,"text":"
"},{"number":285,"text":"- `abg.capability.gtl.declare@5`
"},{"number":286,"text":"- `abg.capability.gtl.admit@5`
"},{"number":287,"text":"- `abg.capability.gtl.serialize@5`
"},{"number":288,"text":"- `abg.capability.gtl.typecheck@5`
"},{"number":289,"text":"- `abg.capability.module.publish@5`
"},{"number":290,"text":"- `abg.capability.catalog.contribute@5`
"},{"number":291,"text":"- `abg.capability.catalog.invoke-graph-function@5`
"},{"number":292,"text":"- `abg.capability.catalog.apply-node-type@5`
"},{"number":293,"text":"- `abg.capability.catalog.apply-overlay@5`
"},{"number":294,"text":"- `abg.capability.runtime.execute-seven-term-c@5`
"},{"number":295,"text":"- `abg.capability.runtime.admit-fp-result@5`
"},{"number":296,"text":"- `abg.capability.runtime.replay-continuation@5`
"},{"number":297,"text":"- `abg.capability.operator.public-contract@5`
"},{"number":298,"text":"- `abg.capability.install.bind-products@5`
"},{"number":299,"text":"- `abg.capability.qualification.self-conformance@5`
"},{"number":300,"text":"
"},{"number":301,"text":"`abg.capability.graph-function.consensus@5` retains its stable identity for an
"},{"number":302,"text":"optional published Consensus claim and the dedicated 5.1 qualification. Its
"},{"number":303,"text":"absence is not a 5.0 mandatory-capability gap.
"},{"number":304,"text":"
"},{"number":305,"text":"The mandatory identities shall derive from one capability-definition graph
"},{"number":306,"text":"whose rows bind the owning public contract identities and dependencies.
"},{"number":307,"text":"Tenant-conformance manifests publish realized claims over that graph; they do
"},{"number":308,"text":"not author another capability vocabulary or infer support from package presence.
"},{"number":309,"text":"
"},{"number":310,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-012**: The tenant-conformance manifest shall reference
"},{"number":311,"text":"only contract and capability identities present in the exact product's public
"},{"number":312,"text":"contract catalog and shall bind the catalog identity/version/digest. Unknown,
"},{"number":313,"text":"duplicate, incompatible, unlocated, or digest-mismatched identities shall be
"},{"number":314,"text":"typed conformance gaps.
"},{"number":315,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":334,"heading":"REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS - Addressable Public Contract Catalog/Builder Walkthrough Contract","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md#REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS%20-%20Addressable%20Public%20Contract%20Catalog%2FBuilder%20Walkthrough%20Contract","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md","sha256":"be1db80bc060fc25457d2fbea4674482d7dbbece27062edb024bc3d6c998a78f","start_line":316,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md","lines":[{"number":316,"text":"## Builder Walkthrough Contract
"},{"number":317,"text":"
"},{"number":318,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-013**: A source-blind tenant builder shall be able to:
"},{"number":319,"text":"
"},{"number":320,"text":"1. verify `product-toolchain-manifest.json` and its public contract catalog;
"},{"number":321,"text":"2. locate canonical GTL, Module, product, install, catalog, operation, event,
"},{"number":322,"text":"   result, replay, F_H, conformance, and qualification schemas;
"},{"number":323,"text":"3. locate the exact event-kind and diagnostic vocabularies and language corpus;
"},{"number":324,"text":"4. construct a tenant-conformance manifest from catalog identities;
"},{"number":325,"text":"5. derive the complete SDK, CLI, schema, and catalog operation projections from the
"},{"number":326,"text":"   same `PublicFunctionDefinition<K>` family;
"},{"number":327,"text":"6. implement a native typed adapter or canonical serialized adapter without
"},{"number":328,"text":"   consulting ABIogenesis source, tickets, design history, or test fixtures; and
"},{"number":329,"text":"7. run conformance and qualification against the same identities.
"},{"number":330,"text":"
"},{"number":331,"text":"Failure of any locator, digest, schema, vocabulary, operation row, capability
"},{"number":332,"text":"row, or corpus row shall refuse conformance; it shall not fall back to code
"},{"number":333,"text":"inspection or prose inference.
"},{"number":334,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":340,"heading":"REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS - Addressable Public Contract Catalog/Bounded Scope","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md#REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS%20-%20Addressable%20Public%20Contract%20Catalog%2FBounded%20Scope","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md","sha256":"c1754ef2558629e842c2d4d5bcdaf15af321ddc2e1f52d60d4f7fc9847d3c36c","start_line":335,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS.md","lines":[{"number":335,"text":"## Bounded Scope
"},{"number":336,"text":"
"},{"number":337,"text":"**REQ-P-PUBLIC-CONTRACTS-014**: The public contract catalog is an immutable
"},{"number":338,"text":"manifest section plus static package exports and schema/corpus assets. ABIogenesis
"},{"number":339,"text":"5.0 does not require a hosted schema registry, runtime schema download service,
"},{"number":340,"text":"signing authority, multi-language code generator, or hostile-local tamper system.
"}]},{"end_line":11,"heading":"REQ-P-QUAL — Qualification Infrastructure","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md#REQ-P-QUAL%20%E2%80%94%20Qualification%20Infrastructure","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","sha256":"ef96624282caa79610fc75e8e7c04f28be8725914429a3c04ccdc1c86a4db398","start_line":1,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","lines":[{"number":1,"text":"# REQ-P-QUAL — Qualification Infrastructure
"},{"number":2,"text":"
"},{"number":3,"text":"**Status**: Active - T-283 base; exact Definition-selected STDO qualification basis
"},{"number":4,"text":"**Category**: Verification
"},{"number":5,"text":"**Date**: 2026-07-25
"},{"number":6,"text":"**Updated**: 2026-10-06
"},{"number":7,"text":"**Derives from**: INT-001 (installed product and release qualification), INT-005 (run governance, failure classification), [PRODUCT.md](../../PRODUCT.md), [SPEC_METHOD.md](stdo://releases/v2.5.1-rc.2/standards/SPEC_METHOD.md) (Verification Layers)
"},{"number":8,"text":"**Wave**: ABG 5.0
"},{"number":9,"text":"
"},{"number":10,"text":"---
"},{"number":11,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":27,"heading":"REQ-P-QUAL — Qualification Infrastructure/Purpose","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md#REQ-P-QUAL%20%E2%80%94%20Qualification%20Infrastructure%2FPurpose","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","sha256":"b4e1cfc5116b1f2c469947b895c62852d12477034389765f49ffc0bf266e9a18","start_line":12,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","lines":[{"number":12,"text":"## Purpose
"},{"number":13,"text":"
"},{"number":14,"text":"The test and qualification infrastructure is a product surface with its own correctness requirements. Without formal requirements, failure modes are diagnosed ad-hoc, the same defects recur, and lineage cannot be established from intent through to test evidence.
"},{"number":15,"text":"
"},{"number":16,"text":"This requirement establishes the constitutional rules for the qualification infrastructure itself — transport readiness, failure mode separation, artifact integrity, timeout contracts, and forensic evidence. Every test that validates product behavior must itself satisfy these requirements.
"},{"number":17,"text":"
"},{"number":18,"text":"Gate applicability follows [Product Release Boundaries](../../PRODUCT.md#50-and-51-release-boundaries).
"},{"number":19,"text":"Standalone Consensus, mandatory host parity, native human response/resume and
"},{"number":20,"text":"the dedicated F12/S04 observer/tuner Product are 5.1 qualification claims. Their
"},{"number":21,"text":"deferral does not waive retained local traversal, truthful blocking, runtime
"},{"number":22,"text":"liveness, complete selected F17/S06 outcomes or actual human RC acceptance.
"},{"number":23,"text":"The selected ordinary governance/default-library discriminator follows
"},{"number":24,"text":"`REQ-P-SCENARIOS-018` within existing S02/S03/S06, not an additional campaign.
"},{"number":25,"text":"
"},{"number":26,"text":"---
"},{"number":27,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":37,"heading":"REQ-P-QUAL — Qualification Infrastructure/Transport Readiness","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md#REQ-P-QUAL%20%E2%80%94%20Qualification%20Infrastructure%2FTransport%20Readiness","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","sha256":"659bfc7f7e3480d0b7789ce9c9cb1eaedabef5c927b9a4c96095aeef16f75e50","start_line":28,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","lines":[{"number":28,"text":"## Transport Readiness
"},{"number":29,"text":"
"},{"number":30,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-001**: An agent skip gate shall verify that the agent is **ready to serve requests**, not merely present on PATH. Readiness means the agent can accept a prompt and return a coherent response within a bounded probe timeout.
"},{"number":31,"text":"
"},{"number":32,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-002**: When a readiness probe fails, the test shall be **skipped with a diagnostic reason**, not failed. "Agent not ready" is an environment precondition, not a test failure.
"},{"number":33,"text":"
"},{"number":34,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-003**: The readiness probe shall be the **cheapest reliable check** — a trivial prompt with a deterministic expected response. It shall not perform substantive work or consume significant resources.
"},{"number":35,"text":"
"},{"number":36,"text":"---
"},{"number":37,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":49,"heading":"REQ-P-QUAL — Qualification Infrastructure/Failure Mode Separation","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md#REQ-P-QUAL%20%E2%80%94%20Qualification%20Infrastructure%2FFailure%20Mode%20Separation","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","sha256":"fcc88fdd191c78855cb691246dff079f80b3f1dfc1eb7f877ca2dc16df263ed9","start_line":38,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","lines":[{"number":38,"text":"## Failure Mode Separation
"},{"number":39,"text":"
"},{"number":40,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-004**: Each failure class in the INT-005 taxonomy (`transport_failure`, `no_output`, `contract_failure`, `certification_failure`) shall produce a **distinct, diagnosable signal** in test output. A test observer shall be able to determine the failure class from the test output alone, without reading source code.
"},{"number":41,"text":"
"},{"number":42,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-005**: Transport failures (nonzero exit, timeout, crash) shall remain **diagnosable transport truth**. They shall not be masked as artifact quality failures or silently converted to empty output. A preserved artifact may only rescue the turn when ABG deterministically validates it as the authoritative result for that boundary; mere artifact presence is insufficient.
"},{"number":43,"text":"
"},{"number":44,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-006**: The actual selected transport shall preserve nonzero exit,
"},{"number":45,"text":"crash and timeout as failure with attributable stdout/stderr and process truth;
"},{"number":46,"text":"failed output shall not be admitted as success merely because bytes exist.
"},{"number":47,"text":"
"},{"number":48,"text":"---
"},{"number":49,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":59,"heading":"REQ-P-QUAL — Qualification Infrastructure/Artifact Integrity","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md#REQ-P-QUAL%20%E2%80%94%20Qualification%20Infrastructure%2FArtifact%20Integrity","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","sha256":"cb970c626737bb54b1d1f6792c349b0b36257f36620573427a761238c67e81bc","start_line":50,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","lines":[{"number":50,"text":"## Artifact Integrity
"},{"number":51,"text":"
"},{"number":52,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-007**: If the agent did not write the expected artifact file, the test infrastructure shall raise an **artifact-missing error** with diagnostic context (raw response preview, expected path). It shall not substitute the agent's stdout as the artifact.
"},{"number":53,"text":"
"},{"number":54,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-008**: The deterministic judge shall only evaluate artifacts that were **written by the agent through the tool surface**, not artifacts synthesized from transport output by the test harness. Fallback masking converts transport/readiness failures into artifact-quality failures, making diagnosis impossible.
"},{"number":55,"text":"
"},{"number":56,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-009**: When an artifact exists but is below a minimum viable size (e.g., placeholder content), it shall be treated as **no_output**, not as a valid artifact to judge.
"},{"number":57,"text":"
"},{"number":58,"text":"---
"},{"number":59,"text":"
"}]},{"end_line":75,"heading":"REQ-P-QUAL — Qualification Infrastructure/Timeout Contracts","id":"urn:a-c:project:3267f8b99452db6ee9e5991cf3b117ab6b31b1323e90e18af7adc6546d9f0420/source/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md#REQ-P-QUAL%20%E2%80%94%20Qualification%20Infrastructure%2FTimeout%20Contracts","path":"specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","sha256":"fce199f78c29fe2e9d2feaadf880c5500ce85ea682f8b6d3c37351189d6176fe","start_line":60,"source_file":"/Users/jim/src/apps/specification_methodology/stdo_skills/.ai-workspace/work/T003_PROJECT_REPRESENTATION/abiogenesis-01/run/generation/corpus/specification/requirements/product/REQ-P-QUAL.md","lines":[{"number":60,"text":"## Timeout Contracts
"},{"number":61,"text":"
"},{"number":62,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-010**: Selected test, command, native actor and caller supervision
"},{"number":63,"text":"bounds shall be explicit and proportional to the declared ask, with each
"},{"number":64,"text":"applicable layer identified. No particular test runner or historical default
"},{"number":65,"text":"is mandated.
"},{"number":66,"text":"
"},{"number":67,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-011**: Enclosing supervision shall allow the selected lower owner
"},{"number":68,"text":"to report its terminal result and preserve failure evidence. A deadline or
"},{"number":69,"text":"process termination shall identify the layer and bound; it shall not be
"},{"number":70,"text":"reported as a completed test or successful qualification.
"},{"number":71,"text":"
"},{"number":72,"text":"**REQ-P-QUAL-012**: When a transport timeout fires, the resulting error shall **name the timeout value and the agent** so the operator can distinguish "agent was slow" from "transport configuration too aggressive."
"},{"number":73,"text":"
"},{"number":74,"text":"---
"},{"number":75,"text":"
"}]}]
